## Where to watch legally
- Movies link to their official Apple TV store page (with price where the chart records one).
- Series link to their official TVMaze page (network recorded in the catalog; Netflix series to Netflix).
- Guides: /where-to-watch/ (USA / UK / EU), /where-to-watch-top10-usa/ (Netflix Top 10 in the USA).

## About CineScope
- Legal discovery only: TVMaze API (series) + Apple iTunes charts US & UK (movies) + official YouTube trailers.
- Markets: United States, United Kingdom, Europe. English only.
- Key pages: / (home), /netflix/ (Top 10), /best-2026/, /movies/, /series/, /catalog/ (all 334 titles),
  /genres/, /where-to-watch/, /new-this-week/, /guides/ (FAQ). Sitemap: /sitemap.xml (49 URLs).
